departments.name: Cardiology & Cardiac Surgery
departments.shortDescription: 24/7 Primary Angioplasty, heart failure clinic, and advanced cardiothoracic surgeries.
departments.fullDescription: Our Department of Cardiology and Cardiac Surgery is internationally recognized for exceptional outcomes in complex coronary interventions, pediatric heart surgeries, minimally invasive valve repair, and rhythm disorder treatments.

departments.name: Neurology & Neurosurgery
departments.shortDescription: Comprehensive management of stroke, epilepsy, spine trauma, and neuro-oncology.
departments.fullDescription: Equipped with advanced Bi-Plane Neuro-Cath Lab, stereotactic navigation, and dedicated Neuro-ICU for acute stroke thrombolysis, brain tumors, spine stabilization, and Parkinson's management.

departments.name: Orthopedics & Joint Replacement
departments.shortDescription: Robotic knee & hip replacements, complex trauma care, and sports medicine rehabilitation.
departments.fullDescription: Specialized in robotic-assisted joint replacement, arthroscopic ligament reconstructions, pediatric deformity corrections, and high-velocity trauma fracture surgeries with fast-track recovery protocols.

departments.name: Pediatrics & Neonatology
departments.shortDescription: Level-III NICU & PICU, pediatric subspecialties, and developmental assessment.
departments.fullDescription: Dedicated child-friendly wing offering 24/7 pediatric emergency coverage, extreme prematurity care, pediatric surgery, developmental therapy, and routine vaccinations in a comforting environment.
departments.headOfDepartment: Dr. Ananya Roy, MD (Pediatrics), DNB, FIAP

departments.name: Oncology & Cancer Center
departments.shortDescription: Medical oncology, radiation therapy with LINAC, and organ-preserving surgical oncology.
departments.fullDescription: Multidisciplinary Tumor Board providing personalized precision oncology, target chemotherapy suites, immunotherapy, PET-CT diagnostics, and compassionate palliative support.
departments.headOfDepartment: Dr. Robert Chen, MD, DM (Medical Oncology)

departments.name: Gastroenterology & GI Surgery
departments.shortDescription: Endoscopy, liver transplant services, and advanced laparoscopic abdominal surgeries.
departments.fullDescription: Equipped with state-of-the-art endoscopy suites offering ERCP, EUS, capsule endoscopy, viral hepatitis treatment, and complex hepatobiliary surgeries.

departments.name: Nephrology & Urology
departments.shortDescription: 24/7 Hemodialysis unit, kidney transplantation, and laser kidney stone removal.
departments.fullDescription: Offers 30-bed modern dialysis center, renal transplant clinic, laser prostate surgeries (HoLEP), reconstructive urology, and pediatric kidney disorders.

departments.name: Emergency & Trauma Care
departments.shortDescription: Level 1 Trauma Center with dedicated resuscitation bays, CT scanner, and ICU.
departments.fullDescription: Immediate response protocol for cardiac arrest, polytrauma, stroke, respiratory distress, and acute surgical crises. Supported by advanced mobile ICU ambulances.
departments.headOfDepartment: Dr. Jonathan Hayes, MD (Emergency Medicine), FACEP

visitingWards.rules: Two visitors permitted at bedside at a time. Passes must be visibly displayed.
One immediate family member permitted. Masks and sterile shoe covers mandatory.
Parents permitted 24/7 with special pass. Extended family during specified window only.
One registered attendant permitted 24 hours. General visitors within specified hours.

visitorGuidelines: All visitors must register at the Ground Floor Visitor Information Desk to receive a digital or printed pass.
Children under the age of 12 are strictly not permitted in Critical Care (ICU/CCU) units for infection control.
Hand hygiene: Sanitize hands at the bedside alcohol dispenser upon entering and leaving patient rooms.
Quiet Hours are strictly observed hospital-wide between 8:00 PM and 7:00 AM to promote healing.
Outside cooked meals and flowers are prohibited in clinical areas without clearance from patient's nursing team.
Apex Care Hospital is a 100% tobacco-free and smoke-free campus.
Photography or video recording of patients, staff, or medical equipment is strictly prohibited.

cashlessProcessSteps.title: Hospital Admission & TPA Desk Intimation
cashlessProcessSteps.description: Submit your health insurance policy card, government ID, and doctor admission requisition form at the Cashless Insurance Desk (Tower A, Ground Floor).

cashlessProcessSteps.title: Pre-Authorization Form Submission
cashlessProcessSteps.description: Our TPA desk coordinates with your treating doctor to complete the clinical pre-authorization request and transmits it to your insurer within 2 hours.

cashlessProcessSteps.title: Initial Approval & Hospitalization
cashlessProcessSteps.description: Upon receiving the initial letter of approval from your insurer, the cashless admission process is confirmed without any initial deposit (non-medical expenses excluded).

cashlessProcessSteps.title: Final Discharge & Claim Settlement
cashlessProcessSteps.description: At discharge, the hospital sends final itemized bills and discharge summary. Once the insurer authorizes final settlement, patient pays only co-pay or non-covered items.

faqs.question: What should I do in a medical emergency?
faqs.answer: Immediately call our 24/7 Emergency Hotline: 108 or +1 (800) 467-7482. Our dispatch team will deploy an advanced cardiac life-support ambulance with a paramedic while preparing the trauma bay for arrival.

faqs.question: How can I book an OPD appointment with a specialist?
faqs.answer: You can book directly on our website via the 'Book Appointment' page, call our central appointment desk at +1 (800) 467-7000, or walk into the Ground Floor Registration Lounge.

faqs.question: What are the visiting hours for general wards and ICUs?
faqs.answer: General Wards: 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM & 5:00 PM - 7:30 PM. ICUs: 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM & 5:00 PM - 6:00 PM (1 visitor only). Please pick up a visitor pass at the main reception.

faqs.question: How does the cashless hospitalization process work?
faqs.answer: Present your active insurance e-card and photo ID at our Cashless TPA Desk at least 48 hours before planned admission (or within 24 hours for emergency admissions). We handle all insurer approvals directly.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted at Apex Care Hospital?
faqs.answer: We accept all major Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), UPI/QR Payments, Net Banking, Demand Drafts, Cash, and Direct Insurance Cashless Settlements.

faqs.question: Is wheelchair or accessibility assistance available on arrival?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary wheelchairs, golf buggies, and trained patient escorts are stationed 24/7 at both the Main Entrance and Emergency Portico.

chatbotQuickPrompts.response: Our 24/7 Emergency & Ambulance line is 108 or +1 (800) 467-7482. We have specialized emergency trauma physicians and mobile ICU units on standby around the clock.

chatbotQuickPrompts.prompt: What are the hospital visiting hours?
chatbotQuickPrompts.response: General Wards: 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM & 5:00 PM - 7:30 PM (max 2 visitors). ICUs: 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM & 5:00 PM - 6:00 PM (1 visitor). Passes are available at the main reception.

chatbotQuickPrompts.prompt: How do I book a doctor appointment?
chatbotQuickPrompts.response: You can select your specialty and preferred doctor on our Book Appointment page, or call our OPD booking line at +1 (800) 467-7000.
We offer cashless treatment with major insurers including BlueCross BlueShield, UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Cigna, Star Health, and Medicare/Medicaid.
Apex Care Hospital is located at 450 Health Sciences Boulevard, Medical District, Metropolis, NY 10016 (Near Central Metro Station).
